title: Single-cell multi-omic profiling allows the dissection of peripheral immune phenotypes in Alzheimer’s Disease progression

AD progression in contrast to healthy aging across cohorts

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: An empirical human immune study that explicitly contrasts findings with healthy aging and reports completed multi-omic profiling.
